output.summary: ED nurse staffing is flat (hours per visit, vacancy and grid compliance unchanged), and about 3.0 of the 3.2 h LOS rise is in the boarding interval, which is timestamped independently of nursing. The rise began in March, when the rounding change pushed medical-ward discharges later (before-noon departures fell from 29% to 9%). Staffed beds and occupancy are unchanged. The 4 West huddle pilot is credible, because the huddle days were set by a schedule made before the pilot and the huddle and non-huddle days were comparable. It halved boarding for 4 West beds. Travel nurses, funded by deferring case managers, and floating the 4 West charge nurse would likely worsen boarding. The bed-cleaning cut is unquantified. The front-end LWBS rise coincides with the triage-provider cut.
